title: Drip irrigation suppliers for Kenyan smallholders
brief:
Project: Shamba Water

Our agricultural cooperative in Kenya wants to find suppliers of drip irrigation equipment in East Africa that offer financing or pay-as-you-go plans to smallholder farmers. Exclude suppliers that only sell to large commercial farms. We need supplier name, countries served, financing model, minimum order size and a public sales contact. We will contact them by phone or email to request quotes.
